about: How 十千脚店's nine entities are built where the kit departs from its kind's default or from a placeholder footprint. Every size the strokes can't give is a `choice:` in blender/kit_rainbow_bridge_area.py. No entity is moved and none is unbuilt.

S3.bld.tavern_river_hall_15540.why: two storeys as tested (平坐 over 腰檐): the upper floor a colliding slab at the frame's measured 3.83 m over the balcony and the rooms behind it (all 7 mapped upper-floor figures and 5 props ground on it; nothing collides between it and 5.1 m above them). Its footprint is a placeholder: built X 96.75-107.0 (the upper storey's east end at its painted post u 16296 on the window wall's line, plus a 1.5 m side gallery for its two figures at X 106.3-106.7; its west end at X 96.75, 0.5 m east of the painted corner post u 15592, clear of S4b's south hall as S4b built it (walls to x 96.2, eave ~0.5 m beyond at z 3.4-3.85), which the painting shows overlapping the hall's west end), D -4.0 (the balcony's edge, 0.1 behind the est front) to 1.69 (1.5 m short of the route's edge); the window wall on D -2.1, set by the doorway figure painted standing in the doorway (D -2.3) and the rack painted at the back of the middle bay (D -2.34); its bays at the painted posts. Upper eave 7.1 m (sw_eave measured 7.27 at the est base), ridge 8.6 (painted 8.5 at the roof's est depth), the ridge nearly the eave's length with short steep hip skirts as painted (ridge X 96.5-106.5). The pent roof only under the balcony's east part, as painted (u 15955-16300). The lower storey's walls are not painted (bare trees and silk): plain plaster walls with timber posts, a door (invisible board) and two windows on the route side.

S3.bld.tavern_wing_16300.why: built wider than its placeholder footprint: walls X 107.0-112.4 (footprint 107.0-110.6), D -3.6..0.45. The painted east eave (16880,1508)->(16602,1787) at a real eave height of 3.1 m lies on X ~114.3, over the 杈子; the eave is kept at X 113.55 (0.4 m short of the 杈子 at X 113.94) and the east wall 1.15 m in from it, so bare ground lies under the eave as painted (the placeholder's wall at X 110.6 left a 3 m gap the scroll doesn't paint). The ridge at its painted place (X 109.5, from (16420,1470) and (16710,1160) at 5.0 m). The south gable wall stands 0.4 m behind the two bare trees painted at the bottom edge in front of it (D -4.04; with the footprint's -4.45 they stood inside the wall).

S3.bld.tavern_gate_16870.why: an open gatehouse (门楼): no closed walls, four posts to the ground plus the two thin painted posts, the 垂柱 at the west front ending in mid-air at its painted knob (2.9 m), the valance, three boards (all illegible: □□□□, □□, □□ smudges), the striped curtain (kit_common.swag_curtain, a stand-in until it lands), the slatted panel with a curved top, the carved door leaf standing open; walkable from the open ground behind it to the bar fence. Its roof is flat-topped (盝顶) at the measured eave 5.49 (an upper bound from an est base, kept so the scaffold that stands on it projects onto its painted poles), its deck carrying the 彩楼欢门.

S3.str.cailou_huanmen_16880.why: the set piece, built on the gate's roof deck (not on the ground): a lashed cage (the diamond-lattice parapet, posts, the four painted tiers as ledgers, the dense uprights) and the 18 painted poles (plain, fans, A-frames, three bound spires and a short one) from structures_w's pole-by-pole points (map/strokes/S3.json, scan px; layout.json carries only the base), each placed at a chosen depth on the roof with the frame F1, so from the scroll's view every top projects onto its painted stroke. No flowers, streamers or lamps (as painted). Tallest top 15.0 m (pole15, painted (17230, 499)).

S3.str.chazi_barrier_16800.why: built as the map reads it, a 杈子 of crossed bars between two rails (1.05 m; painted 1.2 at 77 px/m), with the capped box post where the painted foot line passes u 16905; t2's other reading (a railed stair up to the gate) is not built.

S3.prop.lamp_box_jiaodian_17035.why: face 0.55 x 1.25 m on 0.7 m legs behind the bar fence: painted, its foot meets the fence's top in the scroll's view (H 0.37 at its depth); raised so both 腳 and 店 clear the 1.15 m fence for a walker in front of the gate. 腳店 on its south face and 十千 (small, faint) on its east face, from the section's sign atlas, as painted.

S3.prop.xinjiu_flagpole_17630.why: the pole at its est base (D 3.22, foot hidden behind the 串车's load), top, crossbar, bird vane (head west) and X-frame at their painted heights. The bar is level at the height painted at the pole (6.43 m) and tied to the scaffold's north-east post: painted, it is level across the picture from a pole at D 3.2 to a scaffold at D <= -0.9, which no level bar can be (it would climb 2.9 m to meet the painted tie), so it meets the scaffold 2.9 m lower than painted. The banner hangs from its own yard under the bar's east half, centred where it is painted (u 17428-17562), facing south as painted (the bar itself runs mostly north-south). The two guy ropes painted from the banner's west corner to the big parasol's rim are not built: they would end on the props agent's parasol, whose rim isn't known to this kit.
